description: Write the comprehensive third-pass security audit findings document at poc/THIRD_PASS_FINDINGS.md
steps: Analyze the MTA ZKP seed generation buffer reuse bug in generate_mta_range_zkp_seed where BN_bn2bin writes proof.A into buffer sized for proof.S
Analyze the missing OPENSSL_cleanse on stack secrets in hd_derive.cpp (already known) and validate in context of this audit
Analyze deserialization of MTA range ZKP proof where paillier_priv_n_size vs paillier_pub_n_size swaps could allow buffer over-read
Document findings with section references, acceptance probability, and PoC outlines
acceptance_criteria: Document exists at poc/THIRD_PASS_FINDINGS.md with properly vetted findings
verification: File exists and contains properly formatted findings
findings: 4 findings documented: (1) MTA Fiat-Shamir hash truncation in legacy path, (2) 40-bit statistical security in batch verification, (3) HD derive stack secret leak, (4) Missing key binding in legacy Fiat-Shamir. Paillier batch uses 8-bit gamma values with 5 slots = 40 bits total. Ring Pedersen batch uses 40-bit gamma with single accumulated check = 40 bits. Non-extended seed path is used for range_proof_exponent_zkpok and range_proof_diffie_hellman_zkpok even on new versions (hardcoded use_extended_seed=0 in signing services).
